summary: Frontend-only i18n check of the whole Company panel (/company) using the company E2E cookie session and the real header toggle (compact-lang-switcher). Static check: every literal t('company.*') key in the 10 company files exists in both es.json and en.json, and the 'company' namespaces match exactly in both files. Dynamic enum keys (status/modality/pricing/priceUnit/move/tabs) all have entries. UI: all 11 tabs (overview, stores, products, services, bookings, inventory, deliveries/Courier, wallet/Balance, tools, kyc/Verification, security) were swept in EN -> ES -> EN at 1920x800. Result: 0 raw 'company.*' keys in innerText or in placeholder/title/aria-label. In EN, a scan for leftover Spanish UI words found none on any tab or in the New service, New product, New store and Request delivery dialogs. In ES, the services/products dialogs and all tabs had no leaks. The service-dialog calendar follows the language (October/Mo Tu... vs octubre/lu ma...). User data stays untranslated as expected (service titles, DB category 'Otros', 'Asesoría'). Mobile 390x844 in both languages: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth == innerWidth) and the service dialog fits (358px wide). One minor header clipping issue on mobile. No console errors.

ui_bugs.issue: The header label (t('company.panel.headerLabel'), 'BUSINESS PANEL' / 'PANEL EMPRESA') wraps to 2 lines and the company name wraps to 3 lines inside the fixed h-16 header. The first line of the label renders at top=-9px and is clipped, so only 'PANEL' (EN) or 'EMPRESA' (ES) shows. This happens in both languages. Fix: add whitespace-nowrap/truncate to the label and truncate the name (min-w-0, truncate), or use h-auto/min-h-16.

issues: Inconsistent section label: Stores/Courier/Bookings/Inventory/Wallet use sectionLabel 'Business', while Products and Services use 'Company' (en.json ~lines 5847 and 5918). Pick one term.
Native <input type=file> shows browser-locale 'Choose File / No file chosen' even in Spanish. Consider a custom localized file button (cosmetic).

action_items: LOW: Fix mobile header clipping in CompanyPanel.jsx (label wraps and the top line is cut off at 390px).
LOW: Make the EN sectionLabel consistent ('Business' vs 'Company') across company views.
OPTIONAL: Localize the native file-input button text.
critical_code_review_comments: Every static company.* key resolves in both locales, and the es and en company namespaces have the same key sets.

Dynamic keys rely on backend enums. If the backend adds a new status/modality/pricing_type, CompanyServicesView priceUnit (line ~193) has no defaultValue and would leak a raw key. Its hasUnit guard protects it today.
seed_data_creation: None. Used the existing test_session_empresa_e2e_X company account.
